title: The Dark Antenna — EN/JA/ZH (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 94bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic dark signal language learning EN JA ZH
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The dark antenna stands against the winter sky
It pulls in frequencies that ordinary ears pass by
A tower in the silence, a receiver in the dark
It intercepts the signals from the universe's heart

[Verse 2 — Japanese, with English translation]
暗いアンテナが夜空に立っている
[The dark antenna stands in the night sky]
宇宙の声を静かに受け取っている
[Quietly receiving the voice of the universe]
電波の中に隠れた真実がある
[Within the radio waves, hidden truths exist]
アンテナは聴く、私たちが忘れたことを
[The antenna listens to what we have forgotten]

[Chorus — English]
Dark antenna, reach the sky
Pull the signal from the stars that passed us by
Dark antenna, cold and tall
You receive the frequencies we cannot call

[Bridge — Chinese Mandarin, with English translation]
黑暗天线指向无尽的天空
[The dark antenna points to the endless sky]
它捕捉那些迷失的声音和歌
[It captures those lost sounds and songs]
在电磁波中，有远古的低语
[In the electromagnetic waves, there are ancient whispers]
天线知道，我们从何而来
[The antenna knows where we came from]

[Outro — All three languages]
Dark antenna… 暗いアンテナ… 黑暗天线
Receiving everything — すべてを受け取る — 接收一切
That's my boy
